summary: The introductory guide page adheres strictly to the plan, research brief, and governance context. It articulates the operational disconnect between qualification, receiving inspection, and corrective action workflows for Canadian manufacturing teams; contextualizes ISO/IAF APG external provider guidance with the mandatory non-endorsement and standard-edition disclaimers; and accurately reflects the ICC Supplier Quality module's pending capability register status for external supplier portals. It provides an orderly breakdown of all subsequent chapters, details the six core artifacts required for vendor evaluation, explicitly labels hypothetical scenarios, excludes unassigned FAQ sections, and avoids unverified capability promises.
